_comment: Optional overrides for compositor session binds + bindm. Keyboard defaults are baked in compositor/src/binds.rs (incl. Super+S scratch-toggle · Super+Alt+S scratch-move · Super+Shift+S screenshot). bindm defaults: Super+LMB move · Super+RMB resize (empty bindm[] disables). Each keyboard override: { "id", "mods": ["super"], "key", "action": { "shell": ["chrome","beacon"] } | { "dispatch": "workspace 2" } | { "exec": ["proteus-terminal"] } }. Copy to ~/.config/proteus/keybinds.json; then: proteus-compositorctl dispatch reloadbinds
